name: iSTEAM Robotics (Summer Shore)
description_short: A half-day, week-long robotics program at Shore Country Day School in Beverly, MA. It has a morning animal-robotics class for ages 5-7 and an afternoon VEX Go building class for ages 7-11.
refund_policy_summary: Any cancellation costs $100. No refunds after May 31, 2026. You can pay in full online when you register, or use a monthly payment plan, which requires a camp fee deposit at registration.

sessions.name: Morning Session: Life Science - Animal Robotics (9:00-11:30 a.m.)
